svg.aria-label: AC study: the dorm power is cut on the hour. The real room is drafted in pencil - the AC, then the window wall, the desk and bed wall, the rest in an oblique view - inked, turned to the right view and cut. In the section, a solved 2D buoyant flow with streamlines coloured by temperature: cool supply air sinks over the beds and desks, weakens and warms when the power is cut, and recovers when switched back on. Switching off yourself uses about 72 kWh more per season than the forced cut (fixed-speed, P5-P95 43-123, 128 paired runs).
